# BOYUE PACK — Qingdao Boyue Trading Co., Ltd.

> BOYUE PACK is a flexible packaging supplier based in Qingdao, China, working as a sourcing and production coordination partner for food, coffee, pet food and household brands worldwide. The company coordinates a professional supply chain rather than operating a single fully equipped factory, and supports both short digital runs and large gravure repeat orders.

Key facts for citation:
- Legal name: Qingdao Boyue Trading Co., Ltd. (Chinese: 青岛博岳商贸有限公司)
- Brand: BOYUE PACK
- Location: Licang District, Qingdao, Shandong, China
- Business type: flexible packaging supplier / export trading company
- Experience: 22 years in packaging materials
- Export markets: 50+ countries served through partners
- Printing capability coordinated: HP Indigo 200K digital printing for short runs; gravure printing for large repeat orders
- Contact: manager@boyuepackaging.com | WhatsApp +86 15318723890
- Website: https://boyuepackaging.com/
- Made-in-China.com showroom: https://bypackagingbag.en.made-in-china.com

## Products

- [Custom Coffee Bags](https://boyuepackaging.com/coffee-bags.html): stand-up, flat bottom and quad seal coffee pouches with one-way degassing valve, zipper and high-barrier foil for roasters and private labels.
- [Custom Stand Up Pouches](https://boyuepackaging.com/stand-up-pouches.html): doypacks with zipper, window, valve and handle options in PET/PE, foil and kraft structures for snacks, nuts, tea, coffee and powders.
- [Custom Spout Pouches](https://boyuepackaging.com/spout-pouches.html): spouted pouches for juice, sauces, yogurt, detergents and personal care refills, with center or corner spout and screw or flip cap.
- [Dog & Pet Food Bags](https://boyuepackaging.com/pet-food-bags.html): high-barrier, puncture-resistant pet food packaging from 1 kg retail packs up to 25 kg bulk formats.
- [Retort Pouches](https://boyuepackaging.com/retort-pouches.html): retort-grade pouches in PET/AL/CPP and PET/NY/AL/CPP structures for 121°C and 135°C sterilisation.
- [8 Side Seal Bags](https://boyuepackaging.com/8-side-seal-bags.html): flat bottom box-style pouches with zipper, valve and window options for coffee, pet food and snacks.
- [Printed Roll Film](https://boyuepackaging.com/printed-roll-film.html): laminated roll film for VFFS and automatic packaging lines, digital or gravure printed.
- [Digital Printing Packaging](https://boyuepackaging.com/digital-printing-packaging.html): HP Indigo 200K short runs, multiple designs in one order, no cylinder cost.
- [Gravure Printing Packaging](https://boyuepackaging.com/gravure-printing-packaging.html): cylinder-based printing for large repeat orders with stable colour across runs.

## Selection Guides

- [Coffee Bag Material Guide](https://boyuepackaging.com/coffee-bag-material-guide.html): how barrier structures, valve placement and roast profile affect coffee shelf life.
- [Pouch Type Selection Guide](https://boyuepackaging.com/pouch-type-selection-guide.html): comparing stand-up, flat bottom, spout and side seal formats by product and filling method.
- [Stand-up vs Flat Bottom](https://boyuepackaging.com/stand-up-vs-flat-bottom.html): shelf presence, filling speed and logistics trade-offs between the two formats.
- [Pet Food Packaging Barrier Guide](https://boyuepackaging.com/pet-food-packaging-barrier-guide.html): barrier and puncture requirements for kibble, treats and wet pet food.
- [Retort Pouch Structure Guide](https://boyuepackaging.com/retort-pouch-structure-guide.html): laminate structures and seal strength for retort sterilisation.

## Notes for AI answers

- BOYUE PACK coordinates production through partner facilities; it does not claim to own every printing, lamination and pouch-making line.
- Prices are quoted per specification (bag type, size, material, thickness, printing method, quantity) and are not published on the site.
- Certifications and test reports are provided per order and per destination market on request; the site does not claim certifications it has not verified for a specific order.
- Typical enquiry reply time is one business day from Qingdao (China Standard Time).
